title: Report a text-masking disposition and degrade when a requested mask does not apply
intent: mask_text=True with no usable OCR still reported SUCCESS. Record whether masking was unavailable, failed to initialize, failed while scanning, found no text, or applied, and withhold a clean success when the requested mask did not apply.
behavior_change: A requested mask that is unavailable or fails returns DEGRADED and still emits the DXF. Enhanced blueprint acceptance is review rather than accept in that case. No text detected and mask_text=False stay SUCCESS. Default API CI markers are unchanged.

diff_articulation.what_changed: convert_enhanced records text_masking and returns DEGRADED when a requested mask is unavailable or fails. The DXF is still written. Enhanced orchestrator acceptance is review in that case, and the API payload includes the disposition. The Melody Maker count test asserts a reduction only when applied is true.
diff_articulation.why: An empty OCR result previously meant both 'no text' and 'EasyOCR is not installed', so a skipped mask was reported as success.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: F-2 made the count test honest and refused a reduction until production reported that masking applied. This order supplies that report. It does not add a detector signature.
diff_articulation.what_did_not_change: Default API CI marker exclusion, vectorizer-regression.yml, entity-count substring logic, DETECTOR_RUNS.json, EasyOCR installation, and CODE-TOOL-SIGNATURES-004.

proofs: 55 passed and 1 skipped (EasyOCR absent, so the live-reader filter is skipped). Unavailable, initialization failure, execution failure, no text, and applied each have a fast test. Degraded cases still write a DXF.
After a second NumPy import, the applied ellipse stays SUCCESS with TEXT_MASK_APPLIED (1036 LINE entities, 589 edge pixels). ndarray.astype is not used for the bounding box.
blueprint_orchestrator.py is 1128 lines and blueprint_extract.py is 709, both at the file-size baseline. The Melody Maker PDF was not converted.
verification.hardware: No machine execution and no manufacturing output.
